The '''Entranan firebird''' is a unique [[bird]] found only on the holy isle of [[Entrana]]. As part of the [[Heroes' Quest]], players must journey to Entrana to obtain [[Entranan firebird feather|one of its feathers]], although to do so requires [[ice gloves]] as the feathers are made of flame.

It can be found wandering around the northern section of Entrana, near the [[Law altar#Entrance|law ruins]].

On the quest [[Perils of Ice Mountain]], the [[Oracle]] talks about the devastation of Entrana, and in this talk, she also mentions she had taken the form of a firebird, most likely referring to this.
